author: gaxanh
content: The specification state gas will not be refunded via CREATE/SELFDESTRUCT. Currently, this is the only way to effectively create temporary accounts, as using REVERT would result in the loss of previously created progress.

author: chfast
content: This is fixable in 8037. I'd push for such solution. Adding TCREATE is unlikely because core devs are allergic to new EVM features.

author: gaxanh
content: I tried to convince the original author of that EIP, but they ultimately removed the feature. Initially, the older PRs only deferred the refund until the end of the transaction; however, I wanted the refund capability to be broader—applying whenever `SELFDESTRUCT` actually clears state during the transaction (whether in the constructor or at runtime)—and to benefit from the same refill mechanism defined in the EIP itself. If someone can successfully advocate for adding this feature back, I will withdraw my proposal.
